# FINAL Arm Audit

## Image 1: RUN

**1) Sword arm cycle:** HandR tracks through the cycle — back near pelvis at contact (F1, F4), forward at push-off (F2, F5). Range reads as a genuine pump, not fixed. ✓

**2) Off arm counter-phase:** Off arm swings opposite with clearly bent elbow in most frames — interior angles read ~120-140°. F3/F6 (off arm forward) shows a slightly tighter fold, but within tolerance. ✓

**3) Violations:**
- **Backward elbow:** F1 and F4 — off arm's elbow point sits noticeably behind/below the hand, arm kicks backward with the hand drooping low (~hip height or below). Not at shoulder height anymore, so the old bug is fixed, but the back-swing overshoots slightly.
- **Hyperextension:** None >170°. Elbows all visibly bent. ✓
- **Elbow above shoulder:** None. ✓
- **Dead-straight arms:** None. ✓
- Silhouette readability: both arms distinct from torso in all 6 frames. ✓

**Run score: 7.5/10**
Major prior bugs fixed (no shoulder-height backward elbow, full pump cycle present). Docked for the off arm's low/backward drift in F1/F4 and slightly shallow forward punch (hands never reach chest height in front).

## Image 2: SPRINT

**1) Off arm:** Big forward drive visible in F2/F4 (elbow well forward, hand high) and full back-swing in F3/F5/F6 (arm whipped behind hip). Strong counter-rotation, dramatic range — exactly what sprint demands. ✓

**2) Sword arm:** HandR trails behind the torso through the cycle, elbow consistently bent, katana silhouette tucked along the body — reads as a held weapon, not a stub. ✓

**3) Violations:**
- **Backward elbow:** F5/F6 — off arm's elbow juts back with hand flaring wide behind the body; borderline but acceptable as sprint back-swing.
- **Hyperextension:** None >170°. ✓
- **Elbow above shoulder:** None clearly; F2 forward punch hand approaches chest height, elbow stays below. ✓
- **Dead-straight arms:** None — all elbows bent. ✓
- Silhouettes: both arms readable in all 6 frames; slight overlap of hands near hips in F1/F4 but not ambiguous. ✓

**Sprint score: 8/10**
Big improvement — dead stubs gone, off-arm punch/back-swing has real amplitude, sword arm reads as armed-and-trailing. Minor deductions for the F5/F6 back-swing flare and the forward punch not quite hitting the ~53° shoulder target consistently.

## Verdict
**Both images PASS.** Old failure modes (hyperextended backward elbow at shoulder height; straight stub arms; off-arm shadowing) are resolved. Remaining issues are polish-level: run off-arm back-swing droop, sprint back-swing flare. Ship-ready after minor retarget tweaks — no structural rework needed.
